changelog:
Initial release of wechat-articles skill:

- Fetches and converts WeChat (mp.weixin.qq.com) articles to clean Markdown files.
- Extracts title, author, official account name, main content, and images.
- Supports image downloading and relative linking in the Markdown output.
- Command-line script provided for easy article grabbing and saving.
- Handles basic WeChat anti-scraping measures; some articles may require manual intervention.
summary: 抓取微信公众号文章并转换为Markdown格式。当用户提供微信文章链接（mp.weixin.qq.com）或要求抓取/保存/下载公众号文章时触发。
